angle: It teaches backpropagation and network training by live-coding a scalar autograd engine of about a hundred lines plus neuron, layer, and multilayer perceptron classes from a blank notebook rather than presenting slides or tensor APIs.
angle_detail: Start with [08:11]-[14:11] for the numerical-slope intuition on scalar functions, since everything later leans on the nudge-and-response reading of the derivative. Then work through [34:31]-[38:14] for the manual chain-rule pass with gradient checking before attempting the full loop at [107:17]-[135:51], where inputs run through the multilayer perceptron to predictions and gradient descent tunes the weights. Budget for a very long code-along of 146 minutes and treat tensors as pure efficiency packaging, as the lecture frames them. Skip expecting output layers, classification losses, or any exam-statistics content, which the record excludes.
